spec.scene: A steep grassy hilltop patch glows in warm apricot dawn light. At the center stands a weathered metal pole on a rocky mound, with two bright red garden tomatoes resting on a boulder at its base. To the right, a father in an olive jacket and tan hat stands beside a hiker in a navy windbreaker holding walking sticks. Along the sloping left edge, a tiny black-and-white cow grazes on dew-touched golden-green grass.
spec.title: Sunrise on Mission Peak
spec.caption: We reached the pole at sunrise, then talked tomatoes all the way down.
